Memory Paranoia#001.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment...could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#001.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#002.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#002.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#003.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we’re not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but...things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah...how shall I put this... One day they were all...discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Since, erm...since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#008.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Yet, I am...scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there...cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#009.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#010.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#012.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#013.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#014.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#014.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#015.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#015.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#016.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#016.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#017.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#019.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#020.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#020.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#021.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.
Memory Paranoia#021.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#022.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#022.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#023.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#023.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#024.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#024.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#026.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Enter the hole in the wall.

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#029.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#030.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#030.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#031.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#031.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#032.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#033.src: Dark magic? What foul books have you been reading? And what's that in your hand?
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Casting spells with a black spoon? I'm going to get rid of this foul thing!
Memory Paranoia#034.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#035.src: That is an item beyond you, mortal. Give it back to me this instant!
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#036.src: Return the spoon to the Kitchen.

Memory Paranoia#038.src: Attention, attention everyone! I have an announcement I'd like to make!
Memory Paranoia#038.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#039.src: My son, Timothy, has just turned eighteen today.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#040.src: Now, there have been a few slight hiccups over the years, but we've made it through mostly in one piece.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#041.src: And I'd like to say, I'm very proud of him. To Timothy, a new man!
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#042.src: Thank you very much, Dad, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Please, everyone stay calm. I'm sure it's just the cooks spilling something...
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Oh my god... what is that thing?!
Memory Paranoia#045.speaker: Baker

Memory Paranoia#046.src: Everyone out, now! We can't fight these things!
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Chef

Memory Paranoia#048.src: Speak to people who haven't fled from the disaster.

Memory Paranoia#049.src: My god...what is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#050.src: How was any of that even possible? What are we going to tell their families?
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#051.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you...were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#052.src: No, of course not! I overcame that years ago, you know that, I can't believe you still suspect me of-
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: Ah, sir, we did find something rather unusual in the kitchen that might interest you? Maybe?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#054.src: What- Out with it! What did you find?! Please, please tell me I'm wrong!!
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#055.src: We found this charred-looking black spoon. I've worked here for years, and I've never seen any spoons of this style in the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Wait, that spoon? I remember sneaking into your study that one time to get it, but how did it survive the fire?
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Wait, you got it from my STUDY?! You...you idiot! Do you have any idea what you stupidly, yet inadvertently have done?! You must NEVER go in my study!!
Memory Paranoia#057.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: Speak with the Possessed Mr. Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#062.src: IT WHICH STARTED THE WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. WILL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#065.src: Bring the key to Timmy's bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#068.src: Bring the key to the Master Bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#073.src: FROM THE SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#073.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#074.src: BREAK THROUGH THE REALMS TO THE LAND OF TRADE.
Memory Paranoia#074.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#075.src: CORRUPT THE WORLD WITH SEEDS OF PAIN
Memory Paranoia#075.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#078.src: Escape the flaming mansion through the back door.

Memory Paranoia#081.src: No, no! I said three feet left, you absolute...
Memory Paranoia#081.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#082.src: Mr. Caritat! What are you doing?!
Memory Paranoia#082.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#083.src: What are you doing here, Elf? You need proper equipment to be on this site-
Memory Paranoia#083.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#084.src: Mr Caritat, you can't build a house here!
Memory Paranoia#084.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#085.src: I can do whatever I like here, I bought the land.
Memory Paranoia#085.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#086.src: You don't understand! This is where it came... this is where the darkness invaded!
Memory Paranoia#086.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#087.src: Don't be preposterous. I'm building here to show the people that there's simply nothing to worry about!
Memory Paranoia#087.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#088.src: Besides, even if there was something, now that Dullahan's gone, it'll go too.
Memory Paranoia#088.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#089.src: What?! He wasn't the one causing all this, it was-
Memory Paranoia#089.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#090.src: Well of course you would think that. You and him had some... history, didn't you?
Memory Paranoia#090.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#091.src: I... Please, Mr Caritat. You don't understand what you're doing...
Memory Paranoia#091.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#092.src: I am securing some prime real-estate right here. Oh... Perhaps that is why you're here?
Memory Paranoia#092.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#094.src: Trying to expand elven territories, are you?! Well, I'll be having none of that! Leave, before I have my men escort you!
Memory Paranoia#094.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#095.src: Hey! Human! Are you alright?! Please, calm down, quit flailing around, you're safe!
Memory Paranoia#095.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#097.src: Oh thank goodness, you're back to us. I was so worried... er, you might not recall. Let me explain...
Memory Paranoia#097.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#098.src: It... it seemed like you were possessed. You stood in the hall for... I don't know how long. I couldn't snap you out of it, no matter what I tried.
Memory Paranoia#098.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#099.src: Voices that weren't yours, you spoke out their moments and thoughts. The maids, my father... everyone. I... you said what I needed to hear.
Memory Paranoia#099.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#100.src: My great grandfather, wanting to prove to everyone that the forest was still good, built his mansion atop the very spot that was acclaimed to be the cause of the Decay.
Memory Paranoia#100.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#101.src: My father tried to continue the traditions... but all of it was burned to ashes. I must consider myself lucky that I did not fall with them.
Memory Paranoia#101.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#102.src: And what emerged from that spot? Who knows... but, whatever it was... the darkness must have lingered, and drove them all to madness.
Memory Paranoia#102.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#103.src: I'm sorry you went through that ordeal... I would suggest seeing a healer as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#103.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#104.src: I will make sure no one enters this house again. It is cursed. Thank you for helping me.
Memory Paranoia#104.speaker: Atisun
